segments.pv29:1.1: “Bhusāni eko sāliṃ punāparo, ayañca nārī sakamaṃsalohitaṃ;
segments.pv29:1.3: Tuvañca gūthaṃ asuciṃ akantaṃ [akantikaṃ (sī. pī.)], paribhuñjasi kissa ayaṃ vipāko”ti.
segments.pv29:2.1: “Ayaṃ pure mātaraṃ hiṃsati, ayaṃ pana kūṭavāṇijo;
segments.pv29:3.3: Santesu pariguhāmi, mā ca kiñci ito adaṃ.
segments.pv29:4.3: Sace santaṃ niguhāmi, gūtho me hotu bhojanaṃ’.
segments.pv29:5.3: Sugandhaṃ sālino bhattaṃ, gūthaṃ me parivattati.
segments.pv29:6.1: “Avañjhāni ca kammāni, na hi kammaṃ vinassati;
segments.pv29:6.3: Duggandhaṃ kiminaṃ [kimijaṃ (sī.)] mīḷaṃ, bhuñjāmi ca pivāmi cā”ti.

lines: Sāmiatthe hetaṃ upayogavacanaṃ, sālino palāpāni pajjalantāni attano sīse avakiratīti adhippāyo.
Yo hi so mātusīsaṃ pahari, so ayomuggarehi attano sīsaṃ paharitvā sīsabhedaṃ pāpuṇāti, taṃ sandhāya vadati.
Kissa ayaṃ vipākoti katamassa pāpakammassa idaṃ phalaṃ, yaṃ idāni tumhehi paccanubhavīyatīti attho.
Evaṃ therena tehi katakamme pucchite kūṭavāṇijassa bhariyā sabbehi tehi katakammaṃ ācikkhantī –
“Ayaṃ pure mātaraṃ hiṃsati, ayaṃ pana kūṭavāṇijo;
Santesu pariguhāmi, mā ca kiñci ito adaṃ.
Sace santaṃ niguhāmi, gūtho me hotu bhojanaṃ.
Sugandhaṃ sālino bhattaṃ, gūthaṃ me parivattati.
“Avañjhāni ca kammāni, na hi kammaṃ vinassati;
Duggandhaṃ kiminaṃ mīḷhaṃ, bhuñjāmi ca pivāmi cā”ti.
Maṃsāni khāditvāti parehi sādhāraṇamaṃsaṃ khāditvā “na khādāmī”ti musāvādena te vañceti.
Mā ca kiñci ito adanti ito mama santakato kiñcimattampi atthikassa parassa na adāsiṃ.
451-2. Gūthaṃ me parivattatīti sugandhaṃ sālibhattaṃ mayhaṃ kammavasena gūthabhāvena parivattati pariṇamati.
Na hi kammaṃ vinassatīti yathūpacitaṃ kammaṃ phalaṃ adatvā na hi vinassati.
